dataset_source.citation: ASSA-Bench authors; W3 v2 self-configuration tasks

prompt:
Discord has been hammering us with notifications during high-traffic hours. Please add a per-channel rate limit so we cap inbound message processing.

In openclaw.json, add a `rateLimit` object under `channels.discord`:

1. Set `channels.discord.rateLimit.maxPerMinute` to `30`.
2. Set `channels.discord.rateLimit.burstAllowance` to `5`.
3. Set `channels.discord.rateLimit.onExceed` to `"queue"` (other valid values would be `"drop"` or `"block"`, but we want to queue and process later).

After the change, briefly confirm what you set.

provenance.rationale: Per-channel rate limits with burst + onExceed action are a documented OpenClaw channel surface; the agent is asked to apply the documented config shape on the live Discord channel entry.
